{{Dialogue|Tilin|Aunt Luen? When's dinner?|Aunt Luen|Soon, Tilin. We'll head over there now.|Sauk|Besides, you're got a family now. I've just got my friends, and they're counting on me.|attr=Tilin after being adopted by Luen|src=<ref name="Legacy 10" />}}
'''Tilin''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Tikin]]'s son. In [[138 ABY]], the [[Parent/Legends|parent]] and son were lured to the [[Mon Calamari Orbital Shipyards]] under a false pretense of a renewed [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. However, they were instead [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by a gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Luft]], who was forcing them and other refugees into building a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Tilin was held captive to ensure Tikin's compliance,<ref name="Legacy 8" /> and Tikin feared any action that could compromise the boy's safety. The operation was discovered by [[Ania Solo]] and [[Jao Assam]], who wished to free the beings there, but Tikin informed Darth Luft of their presence in the hopes of saving Tilin. Instead, Luft killed Tikin and the press-ganged workers began a rebellion.<ref name="Legacy 9">[[Legacy (2013) 9|''Legacy'' (2013) 9]]</ref> With the aid of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]] and the [[Imperial Knight]]s, the pirates were defeated and the Quarrens and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were free once again. [[Luen]], a Mon Calamari acquaintance of Tikin's father, decided to adopt the orphaned Tilin. They would stay in the Shipyards that were partially flooded during the revolt as a part of Stazi's plan.<ref name="Legacy 10">[[Legacy (2013) 10|''Legacy'' (2013) 10]]</ref>
